title: Peak-load spike while the router's favourite acquirer degrades
description: The ticket's 'Black Friday spike + Stripe degraded', as an overlay: 26 lines over the baseline, not a 400-line copy. (The fixture fleet has no Stripe; the target is 'delta', the acquirer a router learns to prefer -- degrading the best arm is the case worth simulating, because it is the one where a stale policy keeps paying.) The spike brings 3x arrivals AND a latent-factor shock AND a 90-minute ramp on delta, because in reality those three arrive together and an engine that survives them separately may not survive them together.
